create_fp8_config: create an Fp8Config instance with activation scheme and checkpoint serialization settings
build_fp8_linear_method: build an Fp8LinearMethod to apply FP8 quantization to linear layers with block or per-tensor schemes
run_fp8_moe_apply: run an Fp8MoEMethod apply to dispatch and combine FP8 quantized expert computations
create_fp8_kv_cache_method: create an Fp8KVCacheMethod to support loading KV-cache scaling factors from FP8 checkpoints
apply_fp8_linear: apply FP8 linear computation with weight and activation scales to an input tensor
